description: A backend service is emitting ERROR-level logs above baseline - a functional incident that may not surface as an HTTP 5xx (a rejected internal call, a failed background job, an unhandled exception).

filter.expression: severity_text = 'ERROR' AND service.name IN ('grid-api', 'game-api', 'identity-api', 'billing-api', 'survey-api') AND body NOT LIKE '%no migration could be resolved%'

annotations.description: {{$value}} ERROR-level logs in 5m from a backend service (grid/game/identity/billing/survey), excluding the benign Flyway 'no migration could be resolved' line. Catches functional incidents that do NOT surface as an HTTP 5xx. Open Logs in SigNoz filtered to severity_text=ERROR to find the failing service + stack trace.
